name: Josiah Wedgwood
summary: English potter and industrialist known for scientific contributions to pyrometry and ceramics.

name: John A. Chaldecott
summary: Historian of science and author of the presidential address on Wedgwood.

name: Royal Society of London
summary: Learned society for science where Wedgwood presented papers.

name: Lunar Society of Birmingham
summary: Informal group of industrialists and natural philosophers Wedgwood associated with.

name: Philosophic Society
summary: Society where Wedgwood read a paper in 1781.

name: Wedgwood Museum
summary: Museum preserving Wedgwood's notebooks and specimens.

name: Science Museum
summary: Museum holding a pyrometer set supplied by Wedgwood to George III.

name: Etruria
summary: Location of Wedgwood's factory and home.

name: Wedgwood Pyrometer
summary: Instrument for measuring high temperatures based on clay contraction.

name: Joseph Priestley
summary: Scientist and friend who corresponded with Wedgwood about the pyrometer.

name: Joseph Banks
summary: President of the Royal Society who critiqued Wedgwood's work.

name: Matthew Boulton
summary: Industrialist and Lunar Society member who discussed Wedgwood's work.

name: George III
summary: King of Great Britain who received a pyrometer set from Wedgwood.

name: Philosophical Transactions
summary: Journal where Wedgwood's papers on the pyrometer were published.
